name: Wave Terminal
where_agents_run: your machine, plus remote machines over SSH (sessions can keep running there after you disconnect) and WSL
source_note: Checked against its README, ROADMAP.md, docs/ folder (docs.waveterm.dev source), source code at commit c58bf7f (2026-09-25), latest release (v0.14.5) and waveterm.dev. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Any CLI agent in tiled terminal blocks

harness_count.value: Any CLI agent; only Claude Code has a documented setup

needs_you_signal.value: Tab badges via Claude Code hooks, optional beep

approve_deny_prompt.value: Badge points you there; you answer in its terminal

always_on_assistant.value: Wave AI side panel; can't run commands or direct agents

conversation_gui_view.value: Terminals only; chat is just its own AI panel

session_organization.value: Workspaces, then tabs, then tiled terminal blocks

builtin_editors_browser.value: Code editor, web browser and file previews

appearance_control.value: Themes, backgrounds, terminal font and size

usage_hud.value: None; only its own AI panel's allowance

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Can read another block's output; can't send it input

remote_ssh.value: One-click SSH and WSL; sessions survive disconnects

os.value: Windows, macOS, Linux; no phone or browser access

background_process.value: Yes: its own Go server process

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron plus a Go server)

license_cost.value: Apache-2.0, free; AI panel has free beta credits

extensibility.value: Custom widgets and a scripting CLI; no plugins or SDK

stability_maturity.value: Since 2022, ~22,400 stars; no release since April 2026
